podcast.body: This album, credited to the rock band Santana led by Carlos Santana plus an "army of special guests," was the "winningest Grammy album of all time." It won a staggering nine Grammys at the 42nd Grammy Awards in 2000, with eight of them going to Carlos himself. The album was described as a "Clive Davis-Svengallied album" that seemed "machine-tooled to win Grammys," yet it was a blockbuster that earned respectful reviews and "captured the moment in 1999 when Latin pop was going mainstream." It successfully spun off massive hits not only at adult contemporary and rock stations but also at top 40 pop stations, appealing to teens and tweens. "Supernatural by Santana, the winningest Grammy album of all time."
